dedupe_keys.name: office francais de la biodiversite electricity datasets

description: Office Français de la Biodiversité: electricity datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Office Français de la Biodiversité. Coverage: Office Français de la Biodiversité. The listing groups 14 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about electricity; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: zones d'implantation des éoliennes offshore selon les cahiers des char; Zones propices aux fermes pilotes éoliennes flottantes - Appel à Proje; Zones d'enjeux mammifères marins pour planification éolien flottant - ; Zones propices pour l'éolien flottant en Bretagne. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
